class StringExit {
  value;
  constructor() {
    ((argument: any) => { this.value = "text"; })(this.value = 1 as any);
  }
}
class NumberExit {
  value;
  constructor() {
    ((argument: any) => { this.value = 1; })(this.value = "text" as any);
  }
}
class SkipsDefault {
  value;
  constructor() {
    ((value = (this.value = 1)) => {})();
  }
}
class OptionalCall {
  value;
  constructor(receiver?: { call(value: number): void }) {
    receiver?.call(this.value = 1);
  }
}
new StringExit().value.toFixed();
new NumberExit().value.toUpperCase();
new SkipsDefault().value.toFixed();
new OptionalCall().value.toFixed();
